note: P6-03a shared caller-storage multiply API. Rejected on its own neutrality gate; no production code retained.
gate: direct size matrix within +/-0.5%, results bit-identical

variants.v: v1 pub fn mulInto, re-slices output[0..total]
v3 inline mulIntoExact taking an exact-length destination, each caller slices once
v4 v3 plus mulAlloc keeping its original normalize call

correctness: all four variants bit-identical: 3000 randomized differentials, cross-engine diff, poison-allocator test, test-core 298 passing. The rejection is purely performance.
why_not_keep_trying: nm shows mulInto was already inlined in v1, so the regression is not call overhead, and forcing inline was the worst at 4.40%
the regressing shapes move between variants (2x4/4x2 in v3, 1x8/8x1 in v4), which reads as codegen or layout sensitivity inside a small hot function rather than a locatable added cost
further variants would be searching for a lucky compilation rather than fixing a stable mechanism
not_contradicting_P4_01c: that probe shifted the whole .text block with every symbol moving together and does not cover intra-function structural change
why_not_accept_non_neutral: carrying a 2-4% extraction regression into P6-03c would leave only FAM gain minus extraction loss, which cannot answer what the double allocation itself costs

replacement.approach: P6-03c carries its own basecase loop; mulAlloc is left byte-identical
replacement.rationale: deliberate codegen isolation, consistent with the repo's existing hot-arm non-sharing discipline; both copies are generic basecase multiplication differing only in destination ownership
drift_control: cross-referencing comments marking the duplication as deliberate
lockstep differential test comparing external and inline results limb for limb
existing poison allocator, 3000 randomized differentials, Python and pinned QJS comparison

limits: ReleaseFast, single build instance; the 2.4-4.4% regressions are far outside build-instance spread
no instruction-level attribution of each variant's regression
comptime parameterization and two specialized instantiations not tried
